GPIO_PIN_DOC: Enter the GPIO number to which the LED is connected
ACTIVE_STATE_DOC: Set to 0 when the LED is on at a low GPIO level, or 1 when it is on at a high GPIO level
BLINK_PERIOD_DOC: Enter the blink period in milliseconds (duration of one full on/off cycle)
ERROR_BLINKING_MESSAGE: Cannot change settings while the LED is blinking. Resume or stop playback, then try again.
